name: Coagulation dispels one bleed and only while Blood Shield is up (#587)
contract: Spell.dbc gives Coagulation 706258 Attributes 0x800001C0 (SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE), DurationIndex 21 (infinite) and effect 0 = aura 23 (SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL) at Amplitude 5000 triggering 504102, whose single effect is 108 (SPELL_EFFECT_DISPEL_MECHANIC) with MiscValue 15 (MECHANIC_BLEED) and TargetA 1 (TARGET_UNIT_CASTER). Its tooltip is 'Your Blood Shield now also dispels 1 bleed effect from you every 5 sec'. Two things had no implementation: Spell::EffectDispelMechanic stops after the first match only when the effect's raw EffectBasePoints are exactly 1 and Spell.dbc ships 0, so every bleed was removed at once; and nothing bound the tick to Blood Shield 504296, the only family-26 spell of that name in Spell.dbc, self-cast and granted to class 20 at level 4. Which bleed survives is deterministic: Unit::GetOwnedAuras is a flat_multimap keyed by spell id, so EffectDispelMechanic reaches the lowest id first and stops there. The two bleed fixtures are QA Test 3x Bleed stacks 0 damage 10044 (Mechanic 15, DurationIndex 5 = 300000 ms) and Shanked! 13318 (Mechanic 15, DurationIndex 9 = 30000 ms), so 10044 is the one that must come off. Aura::CalcDispelChance returns 100 here: the dispel is self-targeted, so it is not offensive and no dispel-resistance modifier applies.

steps.label: Let level scaling and login settle
Fixture precondition: Blood Shield is not up
Two Coagulation ticks would land here
Without Blood Shield the first bleed survives
Without Blood Shield the second bleed survives
With Blood Shield the lowest-id bleed is dispelled
Only one bleed comes off: the second one is still there
